name: Squat Strip Miners
source: Mord Hive v0.5, pp.055-058 (Squat Strip Miners). Statlines from datasheets pp.056-057; equipment lists p.056; Squat special skills p.058 (see skills.json warbandSpecific). Techmites (Claim-Jumper attachments: Surveyor 25 tn, Defensor 45 tn, Striker 75 tn) are documented in specialRules rather than being a recruitable henchmen type, since they attach to a specific Claim Jumper and don't count toward warband size or gain XP. Squats have no sourced racial-maximum profile in the PDF text, so their ceilings are left null. specialRules: Squat Strip Miners. All Squats: Hard to Kill (taken out of action only on a 6, not 5-6: treat 1-2 as knocked down, 3-5 as stunned, 6 out of action), Hard Head (ignore the special rules for maces/clubs etc.), Armour (never suffer movement penalties for wearing armour), Hates Orks (hate any model from the Ork Mob list), Incomparable Strip Miners (+1 to the number of Refined Diamantine pieces found at the end of a game). Techmites and Hired Guns are not Squats for these rules. | Techmites (automata attached to Claim Jumpers; do not count as Squats, do not count toward warband size, never gain XP; a Techmite more than 3" from its owner at the start of its Movement phase is stunned; no Claim Jumper may have more than one of each type): SURVEYOR (25 tn; Light Armour, Lamp Pack, Dagger; add/subtract 1 from the owner's Exploration Roll, may range up to 9" from owner), DEFENSOR (45 tn; Light Armour, Shield, Sword; if its owner is charged it may move up to 3" to intercept), STRIKER (75 tn; Light Armour, Heavy Stubber, Club; if its owner doesn't fire, it may fire with the owner's BS and always counts as stationary).
